analysis_role: data quality and group-bootstrap sensitivity only; keep existing primary analysis and frozen targets

normalization.full: Exact graph_id plus sorted complete CPT mapping; roots unwrapped from scalar/length-1-list to float; all numeric cells normalized to float; parent order and axes retained. No rounding/tolerance/hash, no merging merely on graph_id.
normalization.fresh_relevant: Exactly the existing fresh signature subsets for frontdoor and mediation only; other graph types not covered.
normalization.extended_core: Exploratory extension to all graphs: keep all non-root CPTs except the treatment X equation. Equals fresh subset definition on frontdoor/mediation. Root distributions and X mechanisms may matter to causal effects; matching this partial signature does NOT prove identical full SCM or identical query answer.
normalization.scope_limit: Canonical-variable numerical SCM identity, not necessarily the same story semantics; no graph-isomorphism or approximate-CPT merging.
